title: Jalon Daniels will start tonight for Bucs with chance to secure No. 2 QB job

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jalon Daniels will start tonight for Bucs with chance to secure No. 2 QB job
sources.description: Jalon Daniels will start tonight's preseason finale against Jacksonville and will play the first half and possibly into the third quarter, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.
